extracted.intended_audience: intellectual property attorneys, corporate IP managers, AIPLA members, and legal industry researchers
extracted.subtask_description: Extract and interpret economic and practice-mix survey metrics for IP professionals from the AIPLA Report of the Economic Survey 2023 (tables reporting means, medians, quartiles, counts, and subgroup breakdowns).

rubrics_metrics.name: Expected total cash income for 2023 (Q15)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent's expected total cash income for 2023 reported (First Quartile 25%, Median, Mean, Third Quartile 75%)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported with quartiles, mean, median and number of individuals; broken down by demographic and practice characteristics (years of IP law experience, location/metro, IP technical specialization, age, gender, highest non-law degree, ethnicity, firm size/subordinates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of time devoted to types of work (Q18)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of professional time devoted to various work categories (e.g., IP prosecution work; Opinions/counseling prior to litigation/formal ADR; IP licensing; Non-licensing transactional work; IP litigation; Post-grant proceedings; Other dispute resolution; Supervision/training; Office management/administration; Marketing/Business Development; Participation in bar/professional association activities; Managing outside counsel for IP prosecution; Managing outside counsel for IP litigation; Non-IP legal; Pro bono; Other).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as mean (average) percent of time by income level and other subgroupings; tables show totals and subgroup means and counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of time devoted to IP areas (Q16)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of time respondents devote to IP practice areas (Business Law, Copyrights, Foreign IP Law, General IP, Patents, Trade Secrets, Trademarks, Privacy/Cybersecurity, Other areas).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as mean (average) percentages with breakdowns by income level and other demographics; number of respondents per cell also provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: New priority US and PCT patent applications prepared and filed by you in 2022 (Q20)
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of new priority U.S. and PCT patent applications prepared and filed by the respondent in 2022, reported with First Quartile, Median, Mean, Third Quartile and counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statistics (quartiles, median, mean) are reported overall and by subgroups such as location, technical specialization, firm size, and demographic buckets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Billable hours recorded in 2022 (Q32)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total billable hours the respondent recorded in 2022 (First Quartile 25%, Median, Mean, Third Quartile 75%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables show quartiles, median, mean and counts across years of experience, location, technical specialization, age, gender, education and firm size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average hourly billing rate in 2022 (Q33)
rubrics_metrics.description: Average hourly billing rate the respondent charged in 2022, reported with First Quartile, Median, Mean, Third Quartile and counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rates are shown as dollar amounts and broken down by experience, location, specialization, age, gender, education and firm characteristics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of services billed by type of basis in 2022 (Q31)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of services billed by billing basis categories (Hourly Billing, Predetermined Fee, Contingent Fee, Other Basis), reported as mean (average) percentages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented overall and by subgroups (experience, location, specialization, age, gender, etc.) with sample sizes for each cell.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dollar amount billed for legal services performed in 2022 (Q30)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total dollar amount billed for legal services performed in 2022, reported with First Quartile, Median, Mean, Third Quartile and number of respondents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by demographic and practice-group breakdowns; includes quartiles and means to show distribution skew.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total gross income for 2022 from primary practice (full-time only) (Q13a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent's total gross income in calendar year 2022 from their primary practice, reported with First Quartile, Median, Mean, Third Quartile and counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown for multiple respondent categories (Corporate IP Head, Corporate IP Attorney, Private Firm Of Counsel, and subgroups by years experience, location/metro, technology, age, gender, education, ethnicity, firm size, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total gross income for 2022 by type of work (Q13a breakdown)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total gross income in 2022 broken down by primary type of work (e.g., IP prosecution work, managing outside counsel for IP prosecution work), reported with quartiles, medians and means.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes per-type income statistics and counts, allowing comparison of income by predominant practice type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total gross income for 2022 by number of subordinates
rubrics_metrics.description: Total gross income in 2022 reported by the number of IP lawyers and patent agents reporting to the respondent (None, 1-5, 6-10, 11-15, 16 or more), with quartiles, medians and means.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows correlation between supervisory responsibility and income; includes counts per category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amount of year-end cash bonus (Q13b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Year-end cash bonus amount reported by respondents (First Quartile 25%, Median, Mean, Third Quartile 75%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broken down by experience, location, specialization, age, gender, education, ethnicity and other demographic/practice variables; counts included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employer's 2022 contribution to 401(k)/403(b) retirement and savings plans (Q14)
rubrics_metrics.description: Dollar amount employer contributed in 2022 to respondent's retirement/savings plans, reported with quartiles, medians, means and counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented with subgroup breakdowns (experience, location, specialization, age, gender, education, ethnicity, firm size).

rubrics_metrics.name: Corporate annual gross revenues for company for 2022 (Q23)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual gross revenue of the respondent's organization or business unit for 2022 in USD, reported as Mean, Median, First and Third Quartiles and counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported overall and by company technology type and location; large skew present so quartiles and medians are emphasized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual IP budget for company for 2022 (Q24)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual corporate IP budget for 2022 (excluding litigation) in USD, reported with First Quartile, Median, Mean, Third Quartile and counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by location, technology type and firm size; used to analyze corporate IP spend patterns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corporate IP budget per full-time IP lawyer or agent in 2022
rubrics_metrics.description: Corporate IP budget normalized per full-time IP lawyer or agent for 2022, reported with quartiles, median, mean and counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides per-head IP resource intensity across company types and sizes; includes subgroup breakdowns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of IP budget used for specific categories (Q25)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of corporate IP budget allocated to categories such as US prosecution (patent, trademark, copyright registration), Non-US prosecution, and other budget categories, reported as mean percentages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown overall and by subgroups (experience, location, technology, firm size); tables show mean percentages and sample sizes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change in corporate IP budget from 2021 to 2022 (Q26)
rubrics_metrics.description: Categorical change in annual corporate IP budget from 2021 to 2022 reported as Increase, Decrease, or No change with percentage of respondents selecting each.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Results are shown by location, technology, and other subgroupings; counts per category provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reasons for change in corporate budget (Q27)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent-reported reasons for corporate IP budget change (e.g., Economic growth, Company leadership change, Unexpected litigation, Change in perceived value of IP within organization, Political climate change, Change in company revenue, Merger or acquisition, COVID-19, Other).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown as percent of respondents citing each reason, with subgroup breakdowns by experience, location, technology, age, gender, etc.; counts provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technology focus of company or business unit (Q28)
rubrics_metrics.description: Technology type that best describes the respondent's corporation/business unit (Biotech, Chemical, Electrical, Computer Software, Computer Hardware, Mechanical, Medical/Health Care, Pharmaceutical, Other).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as counts and percent distribution across respondents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of annual corporate IP budget devoted to types of work (Q29)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of IP budget devoted to activities such as in-house staff to perform/manage IP prosecution, in-house staff for opinions/counseling, in-house staff for licensing, in-house staff for non-licensing transactional work, in-house for post-grant proceedings, fees to outside counsel for prosecution, fees to outside counsel for litigation, fees for trademarks/copyright registration, supervision/training, participation in bar activities, office management, pro bono, other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Means are reported overall and by income level, technology focus, and other subgroupings; separate lines for fees paid to outside counsel vs in-house staff and by activity type; counts included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct and indirect reports (Q21) / How many IP lawyers and patent agents report to you
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of IP lawyers and patent agents reporting to the respondent directly or indirectly (None, 1-5, 6-10, 11-15, 16 or more), reported as counts and percentages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to relate managerial responsibility to compensation and budgets; counts and percent distributions provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of activities handled by in-house counsel (Q22)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of selected IP activities handled by in-house counsel (other than liaison with outside counsel) by income level: Litigation, Licensing, Patent preparation/prosecution, Trademark registration, Copyright registration. Means reported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mean percentages based on reported non-zero amounts; shown by gross income bands and counts provided.
